changelog:
gmgn-market 1.4.7

- Added Ethereum (ETH) support for K-line and trending commands.
- Introduced the new `market signal` sub-command for real-time token alerts (sol/bsc only).
- Updated default filters: EVM chains now include ETH (`not_honeypot verified renounced`).
- Increased API rate limits (now rate=20, capacity=20).
- Updated setup: use `gmgn-cli config set-key` for configuring API key.
- Expanded and clarified use case descriptions, launchpad coverage, and sub-command documentation.
summary: Get crypto and meme token price charts (K-line, candlestick, OHLCV), trending meme coin rankings by volume, and newly launched tokens on launchpads (pump.fun...
